title: aira alpina subsp. littoralis
intro: Aira alpina subsp. littoralis, commonly known as coastal hair grass, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the grass family Poaceae. It is a perennial grass native to wetlands and coastal areas in Europe and Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce stress and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Aira alpina subsp. littoralis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of soothing digestive issues and promoting wound healing.
